name: Grumgully, the Generous
oracle_text: Each other non-Human creature you control enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
blocked_sentences: Each other non-Human creature you control enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.

needs.what: a negated subtype key (`not_subtypes`, e.g. ["Human"]) in a static ability's `affects` filter, so `enters_with_additional_counters` can apply to each other creature you control that is not a Human
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `enters_with_additional_counters` with affects {controller: you, exclude_self: true, types: [Creature]} covers everything except the non-Human clause; `static_affects_filter_keys` has `subtypes` (positive only), `not_types` and `not_supertypes`, but no `not_subtypes` (the effect-side selector has it, the static matcher `characteristics._matches_printed` does not), and `any_of` cannot express a complement over the open-ended set of creature types
